create_runner_subclass: create a subclass of Runner that implements run, save_state, and load_state abstract methods
test_mockrunner: test the MockRunner class by instantiating it with x, y, z values and calling run to get their sum
implement_preemptablemixin: implement PreemptableMixin in a Runner subclass to add STOPFAIR preemption detection and atomic checkpointing
save_state_atomic: save state atomically using PreemptableMixin save_state which writes to a temp dir then renames into place
handle_stopfair_preemption: handle STOPFAIR preemption by calling handle_stopfair to save state to the preemption checkpoint directory
